tool_args.rationale: The long-horizon probe resolved the key ambiguity: y is positive at short H and negative by H=17.42–24.2. Fit the four amplitudes/time constants of the dual-horizon adaptation law directly to all eight paid rows. Fresh confirmation is addressed by the fitted model's numerical parameter estimation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid short- and long-horizon rows already show the predicted sign reversal and provide eight observations for the four-parameter dual-horizon law; another trajectory batch is unnecessary.
All observed s_grad values are zero, so the sink-coupling coefficient is unidentifiable and adds no explanatory value for these rows.

The observed long-horizon negative response and short-horizon positive gain align with the supplied endogenous-adaptation mechanism; the harmonic form is not supported by evidence of periodic behavior.
